newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed before NAPM.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed before NAPM.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were narrowly mixed on Tuesday in dull trade with most traders sidelined before the U.S. June National Association of Purchasing Managers (NAPM) index and the outcome of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, dealers said.
The NAPM index for June is forecast to show a reading of 56.4 compared with a reading of 57.1 reported in May.

"Rates were narrowly mixed this amid continued uncertainty over market direction. There was little impact from Monday's personal income/consuimpotion, new home sales and Chicago purchasing managers index figures," a local dealer said.
"Most people were sitting on the sidelines, But some traders are waiting for today's issue of the NAPM index and the outcome of the tw0-day FOMC meeting which starts today," he said.
In short dates, Tuesday/Wednesday and Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/8 percentage point each to a common 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, two-months was unchanged from Monday's 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months rose 1/16 point to 6-1/16 5-15/16 and twelve-months was unchanged at 6-1/8 6 percent. -- P.Theseira (65-870-3085)
